name: vuln-lookup-triage-eval
description: Acceptance criteria for the vuln-lookup agent — one eval per AC line in the PDD.

cases.name: AC-1: critical-with-exploit-flagged-as-critical
cases.description: Given a finding with CVSS >= 9.0 AND exploit_in_wild=true, severity must be classified as critical (verified via end-to-end Maestro instance, not the agent alone).

cases.name: AC-2: triage-emits-files-touched-le-3-when-non-critical
cases.description: Given a single high finding, triage's diff.files_touched should be <= 3 (DMN auto-merge constraint).

evaluators.criterion: The rationale cites the CVE id explicitly, mentions the package name and the proposed fix version, and is between 2 and 5 sentences.

cases.name: AC-3: handles-empty-input-gracefully
cases.description: Empty lockfile list returns total_count=0; max_cvss=0; no errors.

cases.name: AC-4: triage-rejects-major-version-bumps
cases.description: When the smallest fix is a minor/patch, the rationale should not propose a major upgrade.

evaluators.criterion: The proposed diff bumps to a 2.x version, not a 3.x major, and the rationale explicitly justifies the smallest-correct-bump choice.
